name: v5.0.0
body:
### Breaking Changes

- **consumer:** Configure byte formats and framing ([#109](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/109)) ([735dc90](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/735dc90c4c1c59f094bbb8a20b155ba62af1dd00))
- **config:** Reorganize client and app settings ([#115](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/115)) ([07de6f1](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/07de6f187612592b709ec82b59331c703c0e304e))

### Dependencies

- **deps:** Update core dependencies ([d6fa331](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/d6fa3314f34f21dec2cb3856fe39581784c7a5ae))
- **deps:** Bump the github-actions group with 2 updates ([#124](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/124)) ([a9ea944](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/a9ea94422bc511e8d38547655b586b346f2bf925))

### Features

- Add Textual theme support ([#72](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/72)) ([a30708d](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/a30708d420cfaea7e5c7d7e24637b060ae490bad))
- **table:** Add stretchy data tables ([#75](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/75)) ([96b57e3](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/96b57e3deb0e4b0b4d3a2100cd1113a4685eabf3))
- **keybindings:** Add configurable vim-style shortcuts ([#76](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/76)) ([e453411](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/e453411b9ebf35d26dad0a27b68e0bcebb352a8e))
- **ui:** Add main view header ([#79](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/79)) ([5a8186a](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/5a8186a4e651241066415d11005250951094fea8))
- **docs:** Generate readme visuals as svg ([#82](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/82)) ([fa0c69f](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/fa0c69f668a5e4d59166917d504b13972eaf9200))
- **consumer:** Export records as json ([#84](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/84)) ([729d979](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/729d9797a00a512ce8c2c066adac1c0d0344cf99))
- **ui:** Copy topics and records to clipboard ([#85](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/85)) ([6c6a09e](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/6c6a09efc7ed19ee6bc086f840b061bbbaee29f1))
- **consumer:** Add explicit partition offsets ([#103](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/103)) ([fb286bf](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/fb286bf304c0f1c58a28a05ead5a9a948fc6e21c))
- **auth:** Add aws msk iam authentication ([#104](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/104)) ([4756fc4](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/4756fc44759083ae951d23e12473c045f90dbf44))
- **cli:** Improve option handling and configuration ([#105](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/105)) ([e4c3555](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/e4c35552ca48f5bf9ffdf330a796a6cb55321ff7))
- **admin:** Add admin topic configurations table ([#106](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/106)) ([65bdc9d](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/65bdc9d745b3d8cf1ef3b9251dac2c30b2e7b0ea))
- **consumer:** Restructure record json ([#108](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/108)) ([85e749e](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/85e749e6f371f923c1980c2ce0d6de24f54478ae))
- **tui:** Add modal navigation shortcuts ([#110](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/110)) ([f00ff26](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/f00ff26eae5861398260d6fae61034ac6435c790))
- **consumer:** Replace python bytes with escaped ([#112](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/112)) ([5d87c0c](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/5d87c0c858480d1ef1c625136dc215a7f4feb37d))
- **logging:** Add xdg rotating logs ([#113](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/113)) ([5d3b78a](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/5d3b78ac2a42e2a55a383926fb99e777eac44e0b))
- **protobuf:** Deserialize schema registry messages ([#114](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/114)) ([8613186](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/8613186d60a7a509ca813b67413325ce342850f2))
- **registry:** Add native apicurio support ([#116](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/116)) ([86f4bde](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/86f4bde75bea4ed47246967aa05ce92d2cee9fe6))
- **site:** Add GitHub Pages landing page ([#118](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/118)) ([44c3aeb](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/44c3aeb4b21833e97fdc17f4f2e3fcec84893e6a))
- Flatten json contract ([#122](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/122)) ([7f734ed](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/7f734ed027d9c4e2eb0813cb13f6c0ffe28f65fb))
- **consumer:** Add structured record details tabs ([#123](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/123)) ([9c36fb1](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/9c36fb10aadefb3c78f279c1631de5ce558adb37))
- **consumer:** Show headers in compact zero-based table ([#127](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/127)) ([d88a16c](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/d88a16c6af0ec30319417806c605ec0732bc327e))

### Fixes

- **docs:** Embed littlehorse badge logo ([352dbab](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/352dbab934e7e783738d4513eab5f862a9aa1d70))
- **consumer:** Focus record details on open ([aff27e8](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/aff27e863405ea061f1f12bee357e7b8a0db35ce))
- **admin:** Validate topic creation ([f4d9d82](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/f4d9d82b55a7e21e3abf3eadafdbd0331536ff21))
- **ui:** Improve help command discovery ([#78](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/78)) ([0b8b1c9](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/0b8b1c9533db151cc9901bf4334ed1e90c105776))
- **docs:** Add intrinsic svg dimensions ([#83](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/83)) ([bbb81b2](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/bbb81b268008ff85c7bee7bb0aadae581858906b))
- **ui:** Distinguish table headers across themes ([#86](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/86)) ([49e446b](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/49e446b5ce65afa7e1ea68fb8bb69664c0b05051))
- **consumer:** Improve record json modal ([#88](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/88)) ([33fc791](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/33fc791bf60c8874c4558701535fd3a9e85d1e03))
- **ci:** Check out tag before GitHub release ([#92](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/92)) ([0dba4dc](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/0dba4dc649c59a384d612bd3104274aecf833808))
- **admin:** Avoid refresh updates after shutdown ([#96](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/96)) ([1b78d97](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/1b78d977844dcfbfbdbd528e5dd4ece57b5adeb2))
- **tui:** Keep table frame visible while loading ([#107](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/107)) ([f868fcd](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/f868fcd6dcfc4586dec90640dae7de22eb8a3442))
- **consumer:** Filter null record content consistently ([#111](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/111)) ([83b83a1](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/83b83a182dcae112fc7a4f6c29f3f20cac702328))
- **ui:** Refine detail panels and focus navigation ([#126](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/126)) ([c8500a0](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/c8500a01c773f85ff0003334a9e1c1d72c49aa4d))

### Performance

- Improve admin refresh and consumer loading ([#77](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/77)) ([ffcc0cc](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/ffcc0cc1a29e63046c8e0e7aec3516f9203fb0b3))

### Documentation

- Update project documentation ([18dc0a2](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/18dc0a279c866c83d6f967d07b07b18936e0efe4))
- **readme:** Improve project overview ([#87](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/87)) ([2b26e6c](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/2b26e6cac21ffbe67045ca2a75586dbf0b29cffd))
- **readme:** Clarify replication factor support ([#89](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/89)) ([327445d](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/327445d8fba283962fb12b1c5ab0a7ee7f2cc899))
- Document warp clipboard compatibility ([#90](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/90)) ([8f0b87e](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/8f0b87e447f70fff0aa62fd93f7ab951a54bc18b))
- **readme:** Update acknowledgements ([#93](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/93)) ([e22efdb](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/e22efdb58f19f7121420b96781a1287e57d1be49))
- **readme:** Reorganize feature overview ([#94](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/94)) ([9562697](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/9562697fbba1c43f3eeece3e7059c91f6ee4aa08))
- Remove hard-coded release versions ([#100](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/100)) ([47c1614](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/47c1614f4c89103394256a9a6713b48ae3daab55))
